chapterName: 第四章：外骨骼兵器工厂
fixedRules: Every layer has a start room.
Every layer has a boss room.
The room before boss is always the Raven Armory Station.
Raven Armory Station contains only Raven merchant and armory terminal; no enemies, chests, or event target.
Boss remains placeholder in this MVP.
